g.text: template=base-4k-4g memory=4096 MiB no pre-created resident pool closed_loop minimal
Points: median of per-run statistics; shading: run min–max, not a confidence interval. Runs/point: 3–3; minimum successes/run: 100.
P99 needs more evidence below 1,000 successes/run. Failure rate includes recorded errors, timeouts, rejections, cancellations and invalid results.
Throughput scope: create-delete churn; latency is the named operation's duration.
